fato_historico: 312: Constantine the Great enters Rome after his victory at the Battle of the Milvian Bridge, stages a grand adventus in the city, and is met with popular jubilation. Maxentius' body is fished out of the Tiber and beheaded.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a triumphant parade as you cross your own personal milestones. Just as a new era once dawned in Rome with great jubilation, you might find that your hard work leads to a celebratory victory. It is a good time to release past burdens and step into your power with a refreshed spirit and clear focus.
frase_do_dia: Your dedication paves the way for a glorious and meaningful new beginning.
significado_numero: Representing the completion of cycles and the wisdom of experience.
conselho: Consider letting go of old worries to fully embrace your present success.
